data.long_description:
Discover comfortable waterfront living in Marina Pearl, ideally located in the heart of Dubai Marina. This well-maintained 1-bedroom apartment offers a practical layout and a vibrant lifestyle surrounded by world-class amenities.

Spanning 971.34 sqft, the property features a bright living and dining area with large windows that allow for plenty of natural light. The closed kitchen is efficiently designed with ample storage, making it both functional and convenient for everyday use.

Both bedrooms are generously sized, with built-in wardrobes providing excellent storage space. The master bedroom includes an en-suite bathroom, while the second bathroom is easily accessible for guests and the second bedroom.

Property Features:
• 1 Bedrooms
• 2 Bathrooms
• Size: 971.34 sqft
• Bright and spacious living area
• Built-in wardrobes
• Well-maintained unit

Building & Community Amenities:
• Swimming pool
• Gymnasium
• 24/7 security
• Covered parking
• Easy access to Marina Walk, restaurants, and retail outlets

Located in Dubai Marina, Marina Pearl offers excellent connectivity with close proximity to public transport, Sheikh Zayed Road, and popular destinations such as JBR and Marina Mall.

Ideal for both end-users and investors looking for a property in one of Dubai’s most sought-after communities.

Contact us today to arrange a viewing.
data.title: 1 bedroom apartment to rent
